messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INC 4705002222 — GeoDNS anomaly: increased 5xx rate from EU region for api.redwood-inference.com. Auto-detected by geo-dns-monitor. Paging @liam.sre and @maya.net

liam.sre: oncall here, looking now. seeing spike in 5xx from eu-west customers ~2m ago.

maya.net: grabbing dig/traceroute from eu POPs. some CF edges returning NX for the hostname while Route53 still serves A records.

aj: quick checks — reproducing:
```
$ dig +short @1.1.1.1 api.redwood-inference.com
# (Cloudflare resolver)
NXDOMAIN

$ dig +short @8.8.8.8 api.redwood-inference.com
# (Google resolver)
52.33.12.5
```

liam.sre: that NXDOMAIN from 1.1.1.1 is concerning. could be a CF edge config or a worker rollout causing selective NX replies.

maya.net: looking at our GeoDNS control plane — weights look unchanged. TTL was 300s. I see a Cloudflare edge worker deploy at 12:40 UTC that touched the hostname routing.

aj: opened ticket with Cloudflare support: CF-78901. sent dig output, timestamps, and affected POP list. also kicked off origin health-checks to rule out backend issues.

ops-bot: healthcheck-results: eu-west probe -> 7/10 failures (502/504) over last 3m. us-east probes healthy.

peter-sre: mitigation proposal (live):
1) shorten GeoDNS TTL to 30s to speed failover.
2) shift GeoDNS steering weight for EU away from Cloudflare -> Route53 origin (80% R53 / 20% CF) temporarily.
3) create emergency CNAME entry pointing api.redwood-inference.com -> us-global-lb.redwood-inference.com as a last-resort fallback.
4) maintain high-urgency Cloudflare ticket and request POP-level rollback of worker change.

liam.sre: do it. aj/peter, can you run the changes and call them out here? we need timestamps for postmortem.

aj: applying Route53 change and TTL update now. pushing small change via CLI:
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z123456 --change-batch '{"Comment":"Emergency EU shift","Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood-inference.com","Type":"CNAME","TTL":30,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"us-global-lb.redwood-inference.com"}]}}]}'
```
Change submitted at 12:49:13 UTC.

maya.net: updated GeoDNS steering weights in provider console at 12:49:47 UTC (R53 80% / CF 20%). TTL lowered to 30s.

liam.sre: seeing DNS resolution in eu now returning us-global-lb. application errors dropping. mean eu-5xx fell from 6.2% -> 0.9% over 2m. good.

cloudflare-support: CF-78901 acked; engineering sees abnormal NX responses from a subset of POPs tied to a worker routing change. rolling a hotfix to revert routing for affected hostname. will update in 15m.

aj: CS reported ~12 tickets from EU customers experiencing 502s — notifying them of mitigation.

peter-sre: additional notes: disabled EDNS client subnet forwarding on our side to rule out ECS mismatch; purged CF edge cache for the hostname.

liam.sre: monitoring for 15m. if stable, plan to gradually restore original steering weights and TTL back to 300s after CF confirms full rollbacks. create postmortem if incident >30m. tagging severity: sev2 for now.

ops-bot: metric-alert: eu 5xx rate dropped below threshold. alert resolved at 12:53:02 UTC.

peter-sre: Handoff summary for night oncall (@mira-sre at 4705002240):
- What happened: Cloudflare worker rollout caused NX responses from some EU POPs -> client-side resolution to non-existent -> traffic failed to CF edges -> increased 5xx for EU.
- Mitigations taken: TTL lowered to 30s; GeoDNS steering adjusted to favor Route53; emergency CNAME to us-global-lb applied; CF ticket opened and CF engineering rolling rollback.
- Next actions for oncall: keep TTL 30s until CF confirms rollback; monitor EU 5xx and DNS resolution consistency across resolvers (1.1.1.1 / 8.8.8.8 / our probes); revert weights and TTL once CF confirms; collect dig logs and histogram of NX responses for postmortem.
- Customer impact: partial outage for EU customers (~12 support tickets), estimated impact window ~12:40–12:53 UTC (mitigated).

mira-sre: taking over. will monitor dashboards and follow up on postmortem items. please paste any outstanding debug outputs here.

liam.sre: thanks team. :white_check_mark:
